description:

Eurovision is in crisis. The continent-wide (and beyond) song contest is divided over the continued inclusion of Israel as a competitor. I spoke with Eurovision expert Dr. Catherine Baker about how countries use "mega-events" like Eurovision as foreign policy tools.

Written and directed by Tom Nicholas.
Edited by Nebula Studios.
